summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for Jakarta EE and Spring Framework 6.0 compatibility validation during Spring Boot 3.0 upgrade. It addresses namespace migration (javax.* to jakarta.*) and Spring 6.0 API conformance—a semantic capability not covered by existing skills. Peer candidates (database dependency versions, embedded MongoDB migration, configuration properties) are complementary upgrade tasks at the same asset layer but target different domains (database frameworks, test infrastructure, configuration). No existing skill matches this specific capability.
